summary: The registrant filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.22 per common share declared by its board, representing a 4.76% increase over the prior year. The dividend is payable on July 10, 2026 to holders of record on June 26, 2026. This is a routine capital allocation action, not a special situation transaction. The filing includes no M&A, tender, activist, restructuring, or other event-driven classification.
